visual_action: A fast-paced montage shows Donald Trump in various presidential settings: in the Oval Office being presented with the FIFA World Cup trophy, disembarking from a plane, and speaking at podiums. On-screen text highlights large corporate investments. This is intercut with a clip from the film 'The Wolf of Wall Street' where a character excitedly shouts about making millions of dollars. The video continues with more clips of Trump and text stating a total investment figure of $10.5 trillion. It ends with a black and white logo for 'THE WHITE HOUSE'.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the subject of the entire montage, shown in multiple clips in presidential settings.

cast.name: AT&T
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads: 'AT&T announced a $250 billion investment...'

cast.name: Mitsubishi
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads: 'Mitsubishi announced a $3.9 billion investment in energy.'

cast.name: Donnie Azoff
cast.evidence: A clip from 'The Wolf of Wall Street' features the character (played by Jonah Hill) speaking. The audio of him shouting is a central part of the video.

cast.name: Gianni Infantino
cast.evidence: Shown presenting the FIFA World Cup trophy to Donald Trump in the Oval Office.

on_screen_text.text: AT&T announced a $250 billion investment to build our wireless network and data infrastructure across the country.
Mitsubishi announced a $3.9 billion investment in energy.
22 Million dollars in three Fu*king hours

spoken_summary: The audio is a mix of a rap song with lyrics about getting rich ('turned to a million, then we all rich') and a clip of dialogue from the movie 'The Wolf of Wall Street' where a character excitedly yells, '22 million dollars in three f***ing hours!' There is no original speech from anyone in the video clips.
audio_music: A high-energy, boastful rap song about making money is used as the background track. This is punctuated by a famous, celebratory and expletive-laden line from 'The Wolf of Wall Street' to amplify the theme of massive financial success.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips of Donald Trump, on-screen text, and a movie clip. The style is akin to a hype reel.
central_claim: Under Donald Trump's presidency, the U.S. economy achieved massive success by securing $10.5 trillion in domestic and foreign investments.
intended_effect: To impress the viewer with the scale of economic investment allegedly secured during Trump's presidency and to associate him with wealth and success.
